overview: The Blue Ball Inn is a traditional inn at Countisbury, on the edge of Exmoor above Lynmouth in North Devon. It offers standard and scenic rooms plus family suites, with breakfast included and a bar and restaurant serving lunch and dinner. Some of the older building's rooms are on upper floors and may not suit guests with limited mobility.
